name: District Electoral Divisions 3 May 1921
description: Northern Ireland District Electoral Divisions as at 3 May 1921. A modified version of the 1911 DEDs/wards map, capturing the three changes made in the six counties between 1911 and partition: the DED of Gortahurk ceded six townlands to Cuilcagh (both in Fermanagh), and Portstewart and Ballycastle each split their DED into urban and rural. Some errors with the map were also fixed (Rich Hill/Aghory, Enagh/"Ballymoney Rural", Derryaghy/"Lambeg", Lissue/Lisburn Urban, Larne, Bangor, Newtownards, Dungannon, Omagh) using the 1911 census reports as a source.
